summary: Today’s pulse tracks Spain leaving Schengen ‘not on table’ says France after Sánchez hits out at EU response to Ceuta crisis – Europe live, Dozens injured as earthquake hits near Naples in seismic swarm, and Top mountaineer Nirmal Purja among 11 confirmed dead after avalanche in Pakistan. Across Guardian and BBC, the strongest repeated signals are avalanche, killed, and world. In the background, Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship and Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says keep the wider picture in motion.

headlines.title: Spain leaving Schengen ‘not on table’ says France after Sánchez hits out at EU response to Ceuta crisis – Europe live
headlines.description: Interior minister confirms France will not ask for Spain’s removal from visa-free travel arrangements, after Spanish PM condemned ‘selfish, polarising’ response of some countries to mass border crossings Back to Ukraine, where nine people were killed in Kyiv this morning from a Russian missile and drone attack. Damage was reported in seven districts of the capital, according to Ukrainian officials, with Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy saying fires broke out across the city and residential buildings, a school and infrastructure sites were hit.

headlines.title: Dozens injured as earthquake hits near Naples in seismic swarm
headlines.description: At least five taken to hospital and about 300 evacuated in strongest quake to hit southern Italian region in 40 years At least 26 people have been injured after a 4.7-magnitude earthquake rocked a region near Naples, in southern Italy. The quake, which occurred at 7.46pm on Friday night, caused power outages, disrupted public transport and damaged a pier in Campi Flegrei, the site of Europe’s largest volcanic crater.

headlines.title: Top mountaineer Nirmal Purja among 11 confirmed dead after avalanche in Pakistan
headlines.description: World-renowned climber had been leading expedition on Broad Peak when avalanche struck A world-renowned Nepali mountaineer and former UK Special Forces member has died after being among 11 climbers caught in a deadly avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak. Nirmal Purja was killed leading an expedition of 10 other people on the world’s 12th-highest mountain when an avalanche struck at around noon on Thursday.

headlines.title: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
headlines.description: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

headlines.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
headlines.description: The Nepali-born climber was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

headlines.title: D4vd hearing details high hopes and brutal end of girl at heart of murder case
headlines.description: Texts reveal that singer and Celeste Rivas Hernandez had been in touch stretching back to when she was 11 years old The rising pop singer D4vd and 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez were in the throes of a clandestine relationship months before her mangled and decomposing body turned up last September stuffed in an impounded car registered to the musician. D4vd, born David Anthony Burke, is set to stand trial for murder, child sexual abuse and mutilation of human remains in connection to the teenager’s death.

headlinePool.description: Italy has temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called scenes in Ceuta "shocking".

headlinePool.title: Spanish PM calls for urgent EU meeting after ‘selfish’ responses to Ceuta crisis
headlinePool.description: Pedro Sánchez hits out at ‘polarising and unlawful reaction’ over mass crossing into Spanish enclave in north Africa Europe live – latest updates Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has called for an urgent meeting of EU interior ministers after what he called some member states’ “selfish, polarising and unlawful reaction” to this week’s mass border crossing into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, in north Africa. More than 50,000 people crossed into the territory from Morocco on Thursday and Friday, with at least 67 people dying in the attempt. Some drowned, while others were crushed as they tried to cross a breakwater barrier.

headlinePool.title: As Reddit stock falls, CEO questions value of Google's AI Overviews
headlinePool.description: Reddit may still be considering ending its licensing deal with Google.

headlinePool.title: Watch: Tens of thousands of migrants enter Spain's Ceuta from Morocco
headlinePool.description: Most migrants who reached Spain's North African territory of Ceuta from Morocco have returned, officials said.

headlinePool.title: Democrats’ ‘climate hushing’ prompts activists to turn up the volume
headlinePool.description: Nationwide actions seek to counter view that talking about climate crisis distracts from affordability messaging This summer, torrential rains have washed away Texas neighborhoods, dangerous heat has blanketed swaths of the country, and smoke from Canadian wildfires has choked communities as far south as Florida. Research makes clear that global warming is making extreme weather events more frequent and severe. Yet the climate crisis has largely disappeared from the political agenda, with many Democrats who once described it as an existential threat now shying away from talking about it.

headlinePool.title: Purple reign: how shade became British gardeners’ favourite
headlinePool.description: Britons move away from trend of grey paving and pristine lawns in an embrace of colour, with lavender a top choice If you manage to spot a garden in bloom this summer, beyond the strips of bleached and torched grass, there may be one colour you see more than any other: purple, the horticultural hue of the season. Plants such as lavender, salvias and catmint are in vogue, according to the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which conducted extensive research into the colours Britons best love to see in their gardens.

headlinePool.title: Opinion: Remembering Margo Howard
headlinePool.description: Margo Howard had a lot of life experience and used it to offer advice for years as "Dear Prudence" for Slate. She died this week at the age of 86.

headlinePool.title: After noise complaints, judge orders Waymo to stop overnight charging in Santa Monica
headlinePool.description: Autonomous vehicle giant disturbs residents' sleep.

headlinePool.title: They call it 'a dream fulfilled' -- new homes designed for (and by) slum residents
headlinePool.description: It's a bold new experiment and it's already won a prize. Residents in a jam-packed slum, many of them living in one-room tin shacks, help design their apartments in a brand new building.
